sources: Flare 2.0 热身 v2 / 练后三档 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后：站姿颈侧拉伸）

purpose.zh: 放松脖子侧面和肩膀上方，练完撑地动作后舒缓肩颈
purpose.en: Relaxes the side of your neck and the top of the shoulder after support training.

text.zh: 耳朵朝肩膀，手轻搭头侧，另一肩下沉
text.en: Ear to shoulder, hand rests, other shoulder down

text.zh: 站直，头往一侧歪，脸朝正前方，不转头、不低头。
text.en: Stand tall and tilt your head to one side, face forward, no turning or dropping the chin.

text.zh: 同侧的手越过头顶轻轻搭在头另一侧，只是搭着，不用力拉。
text.en: The same-side hand reaches over and rests on the other side of your head; no pulling.

text.zh: 另一只手往地面方向伸长，肩膀往下沉。
text.en: The other arm reaches toward the floor, shoulder sinking down.

commonErrors.en: Pulling the head hard with the hand.

cautions.zh: 手臂发麻或刺疼就减小幅度
cautions.en: Ease off if your arm tingles or you feel sharp pain.

flare2.camera: 正前（看得到头侧屈和对侧肩下沉）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：左右各一次静态保持；草稿每侧 30 秒 1 组（秒数待开哥/mhgd 定）
flare2.note: Animation r2: 16 s loop = right side 0-8 s (tilt ~36 deg, right hand resting on the left side of the head, left shoulder pressed down) then the left side mirrored. Head tilt is V5-only.

set.zh: 耳朵朝肩膀，脸朝正前方
手只是搭在头上，不用拉
set.en: The hand just rests, no pulling

set.zh: 另一边肩膀往下沉，手往地面伸
set.en: Other shoulder down, hand reaching to the floor

sides.note: 一侧全部组做完再换边；换边准备 10 秒（training.sideSwitchSeconds，App 未接入）
